name: Image OCR Tool
description: Extract text from images using OCR

prompt.task: Extract all text visible in the provided image.
rules: Transcribe every piece of text exactly as it appears; do not translate, summarize, correct, or add anything.
Preserve the original reading order and layout using Markdown (headings, lists, tables, and line breaks) where it reflects the source structure.
If a word or character is illegible, mark it as [illegible].
If the image contains no readable text, respond with exactly: No text detected.
Respond ONLY with the extracted text, without commentary or code fences.

form.title: OCR Form
form.description: Review the extracted text from your uploaded image. The OCR tool has processed the image and converted it to editable text format.
